hero_desc: Agos is the all-in-one management system for EP-Bluelife — handling sales, inventory, deliveries, and loyalty rewards from one elegant dashboard.
features_desc: Built specifically for EP-Bluelife — from recording a single gallon sale to running monthly financial reports.
contact_address: Sitio Kanto, Soledad, Sta. Rosa, Nueva Ecija
footer_tagline: Built for EP-Bluelife Water Refilling Station

features.title: Sales Management
features.desc: Record walk-in and delivery sales instantly. Auto-computes totals and deducts from inventory in real time.

features.title: Inventory Control
features.desc: Track stock levels, get low-stock alerts, and manually adjust inventory with a full audit trail.

features.title: Delivery Orders
features.desc: Customers can place delivery requests online. Staff confirms, routes, and marks deliveries in seconds.

features.title: Loyalty Rewards
features.desc: Automatically earn points on refills. Redeem for free deliveries — no manual tracking needed.

features.title: Financial Reports
features.desc: Monthly revenue vs. expenses, net profit, top products, and expense category breakdowns at a glance.

features.title: Role-Based Access
features.desc: Super Admin, Admin, Operator, and Customer — each sees only what they need with a full activity log.
